history.summary: IDENTITY UNCONFIRMED — No documented temple named 'Shri Siddhivinayak Ganapati Temple' was found in Godhra after multiple searches (web search, place listings, travel guides). The well-known Siddhivinayak temples in Gujarat are at Mahemdavad (Kheda district, ~90 km from Godhra, billed as Asia's largest) and Mumbai; a place listing shows a 'Shree Ganpati Temple' on GJ SH 152 in Panchmahal district (22.913858, 73.837894), ~27 km from Godhra, but it is not named Siddhivinayak. The CSV row is likely a generic compilation or refers to a small local Ganapati shrine with no web footprint. Coordinates below are for Godhra town (approximate). Do not merge with the Mahemdavad temple without confirmation from the user.

name: Shri Siddhivinayak Ganapati Temple
town_description: Godhra is the administrative headquarters of Panchmahal district in eastern Gujarat and a major railway junction. The town is a noted Vaishnav centre, hosting four Pushtimarg bethaks, and has a layered Hindu, Jain and Muslim heritage.

travel.airport: Vadodara Airport (~110 km southwest); Ahmedabad Airport (~140 km west)
travel.railway: Godhra Junction (GDA), on the Delhi-Mumbai line
travel.road: NH 47 and the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway pass through Godhra; well connected by state buses

visitor_information.opening_hours: Unverified — temple identity unconfirmed; typical local Ganapati shrines open early morning to evening
